description: Only an exact *** divides. The --- further down is back content, not a second separator, and must not be mistaken for one by a parser working from an AST.

cards.headingText: Which rules are not front/back separators?
cards.back:
- `---` is a setext heading marker when it follows a text line
- `___` and `* * *` and `****` are ordinary thematic breaks

---

- Only a line of exactly `***` separates front from back
